items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I wind up at Carl Fisher's and -- on 57th Street, and I said have you got anything on Hammond Organ?

ctx.x: Chicago Theatre, man. And he was on the radio and played all of this beautiful organ. I just used to turn him on and listen to that beautiful music. So I

know -- of course he wasn't playing a Hammond, he was playing that great big -- any way, I said what am I going to do? Nobody could tell me how to write for the Hammond Organ, and so finally I wind up at Carl Fisher's and -- on 57th Street, and I said have you got anything on Hammond Organ? Oh, yeah, they said, we have a new book that's just published. I said, well give it to me, how much is it? $5.00. I said, give it here, wrap it up.
So all I wanted to do was to see how the music was written.
